description.value: Greenrock Liquor is an independent community liquor store in Nanaimo carrying a broad selection of beer, wine, spirits, ciders, and ready-to-drink beverages, with a browsable online catalogue of nearly 3,000 products. The store emphasises locally relevant options including BC VQA wines, Vancouver Island wine, and craft beer, and hosts regular in-store tastings. A touring cyclist passing through Nanaimo will find a well-stocked stop for beverage resupply across a wide range of categories and dietary preferences.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at greenrockliquor.com is active, confirms the store's address as 1860 Dufferin Cr, Nanaimo, BC V9S 0A9, and provides phone (250) 754-7500 not present in OSM. The shop page and front page explicitly highlight Gluten-Free, Non-Alcoholic, and Keto-Friendly beverage categories, confirming that optional amenity. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Greenrock Liquor Store' but the website consistently uses 'Greenrock Liquor' (without 'Store').
Phone (250) 754-7500 is sourced from the website only — OSM tags contain no phone number.

Multiple website pages contain unfilled template placeholder text ('Your content goes here. Edit or remove this text inline.'), suggesting the site is partially incomplete; however, core business information and product pages are functional.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible independent liquor store with a functioning website, confirmed address, and upcoming in-store events. Useful to touring cyclists for beverage resupply.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Front page explicitly highlights 'Gluten-Free' and 'Non-Alcoholic' options; shop page states 'Non Alcoholic, Gluten-Free and Keto Friendly Beverages to suit a variety of diets, preferences and moods.'

Packed lunches.detail: Food service is not part of the business; no food products mentioned
